text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "This is Golshi. I've arrived on site. —Yeah, there's no doubt, it's her!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit…… Ya really destroyed my 
treasure mountain eh! A crime, an 
offence, it's a great sin!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oi, Stay Gold! Let's duke it out, you and me!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The bed! Beeeeed!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I'm back. She's pretty messy eh, that girl.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Jee — For her heap to have made it all 
the way to my bed…… Yep, guess I'll 
just chuck it back to her side.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And there we go…… Ah, it's all tumbled down. Well, should be alright.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaahhhhhhhh! Give it back, give their home back!!! Return the fluffy king sized bed we rolled around innnn!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, aren't you a handful. It's not like I threw them away or anything right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'll have ya know that I've been living 
my life being picky about my interior 
decoration all the way down to the 
nanometre!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ya bed belongs to me! It was decided ever 
since ya left this place 100 million years 
ago! Now surrender!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: So… what if I say I don't wanna?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then I offer my bed to those guys, and I'm 
gonna slip under your covers every night! 
It's gonna be so squished ya know～? You're 
gonna become my body pillow yeah～?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So if you don't want that then it's on! 
Your bed is on the line, let's duke it out!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The first battle, the "Treasure Stacking 
Duel!" Whoever can pile the greatest 
tower of junk wins!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ohh ohh, so we're still flinging stuff around. All right, I'll play with you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Guh…… Aren't you a strong one Stego……! You'll become the greatest "sea bream dancer" at the Gol-Chateau at this rate……!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course. I might even end up 
becoming the most popular character 
under the sea, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My seat as the #1 underwater idol will never 
be surrendered! Do you have even a clue as 
to how many fans I got under the sea, waving 
their little fins at moi, Miss Golshi …!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Taaake this… Ahhhhhhh—!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: My victory eh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next is the "Bed Dive Royal"! The 
winner shall be the one who can achieve the 
most soulful, most excellent, most wonderful 
leap and bow before the king of the sea!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. So I basically just need to pull off a cool leap from the bed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Watch this, the explosion of my 564 000 
Battle Power!! Goooold Spiraaaaaal!!! 
(※Image is for illustrative purposes only)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Golshi…… From that kind of performance, 
I reckon the giant king squid might end 
up actually snoozing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
W-w-what did you just say…? Then show 
me. Show me the greatest of dives that 
would even tremble my heart!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And…… Off I go!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You cheattt! Youu, you're gonna end 
up boiling the sea surface!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gorugorugorugoru… Ahh! Just then! The raging waves completely flung off Golshi's radar!! Diiiiiiveeeeeee!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey now———

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeeooowwcchh!!! The wall sprung outta nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ya really smacked yourself there huh! 
You alright?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: My little heart has been smashed! The tiny pieces are sprawled all over! Ahh, they're scattering everywhere…… You won't be able to find it!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahah…… You really got no limits do ya. You're a handful for real alright!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did something happen in here? 
I believe I heard a loud noise…!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
……What a scene. Could it be that you two 
are in the middle of cleaning… or something 
like that?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well, that sounds about right. We're just collating all the stuff we don't need together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad that you two are such great 
friends however… I would like to ask 
of you two to not end up destroying 
your room alright.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, this wall already developing some 
"aura". It's still glimmering… The honourable 
gash on the wall from the Megaton Mega 
Octopus during our 3 day 3 night fistfight……

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey Golshi, let's go chuck this junk 
out alright.

Walking near the dorms, I saw Stay Gold 
and Gold Ship in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oi, Stego! Our blazing battle has 
yet to end right?
choice_data_list: What are you two up to?
What are you two up to?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah — …We're in the middle of a pretty serious battle. Say, do you have any good ideas?
choice_data_list: How about you two race it out?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then it's time for the race of the "Hundred 
Face Dash" back to the dorms! Get those 
facial and leg muscles pumpin and get that 
groove on! Ready, and Go!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, that one has got a lotta life in her…… 
Well then, I'm off Trainer!

I saw a glint of a gentle expression spread 
over Stay Gold's face as she ran off to 
chase after Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's decide it all with "this". This 
one's a traditional game. Ya got no 
complaints I take it?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
——— "The Dog Game" you say. Sure. 
Trainer, do you mind being our referee?

Suddenly, "The Dog Game" began. I 
acted as their referee all the way until 
the sun went down……
